description: JC Gold by Jamharian Perfume is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. JC Gold was launched in 2019. JC Gold was created by Mohammad Al Attar and Vartan Jamharian. Top notes are Grapefruit, Lavender, Cardamom and Lime; middle notes are Jasmine, Freesia, Rose and Lily; base notes are Sandalwood, Cedarwood, Vanilla, Amber, Tonka and Musk. JC Gold by Jamharian Perfume is an amber-floral fragrance created for a unisex audience. It opens with a bright and aromatic blend of grapefruit, lime, cardamom, and lavender. The heart introduces a floral-green accord of green leaf, lily, freesia, rose, and jasmine, adding both freshness and softness to the composition. The base rests on warm woods and resins, combining cedarwood and sandalwood with amber, vanilla, musk, and tonka for a smooth, slightly sweet and enveloping drydown. Overall, JC Gold contrasts sparkling citrus and spice with a gentle floral core and a rounded, woody-amber base. Its structure follows a classic progression from luminous top notes to a more sensual and comforting foundation, suitable for a range of occasions and seasons.

name: Erato Red
description: Erato Red by Jamharian Perfume is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. Erato Red was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Vartan Jamharian. Top notes are Bergamot, Cassis and Lemon; middle notes are Violet and Rose; base notes are Vanilla, Amber and Musk. Erato Red by Jamharian Perfume is an amber floral fragrance created for a unisex audience and released in 2019. The composition opens with a blend of cassis and bright citrus notes of bergamot and lemon. The heart centers on a floral accord of sweet violet and rose otto, adding a soft, powdery and rosy character. In the base, soft woods, amber, vanilla and musk provide a warm, smooth and slightly creamy drydown.

name: Noor
description: Noor by Riiffs Perfumes is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Noor was launched in 2025. Top notes are Caramel and Milk; middle notes are Gourmand Accord and Lily of the Valley; base notes are Vanilla, Musk and Praline. Noor by RiiFFS PARFUMS is a fragrance that combines sweet and creamy elements with floral and musky undertones. The scent opens with notes of caramel and milk, leading to a heart of warm gourmand and lily of the valley. The base is enriched with vanilla, pralines, and musk, creating a comforting and inviting aroma.

name: Erato Black
description: Erato Black by Jamharian Perfume is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. Erato Black was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Vartan Jamharian. Top notes are Bergamot, Jasmine and Lilac; middle notes are Pink Pepper, Mandarin and Lily; base notes are Freesia and Rose. Erato Black by Jamharian Perfume is a unisex fragrance created in 2019 by perfumer Vartan Jamharian. It combines floral, citrus, and woody nuances, placing it within a floral woody musk style. The composition opens with lilac, jasmine, and bergamot, creating a bright, floral-citrus impression. The heart introduces mandarin, pink pepper, and lily, adding a soft spiciness and a slightly more radiant floral character. In the base, woody notes are blended with freesia and rose, giving a gentle, musky-woody drydown with lingering floral facets.

name: Flamenco Extrait de Parfum
description: Flamenco Extrait de Parfum by Ramon Monegal is a Oriental Spicy fragrance for women and men. Flamenco Extrait de Parfum was launched in 2024. The nose behind this fragrance is Ramon Monegal. Top notes are Raspberry, Saffron and Rose; middle notes are Iris, Cedarwood, Jasmine and Orange Blossom; base notes are Oud, Leather, Amber and Musk.

name: JC Crystal
description: JC Crystal by Jamharian Perfume is a Aromatic Aquatic fragrance for women and men. JC Crystal was launched in 2019. JC Crystal was created by Vartan Jamharian and Mohammad Al Attar. Top notes are Lavender and Lemon; middle notes are Clary Sage, Spearmint and Lily; base notes are Orris Root, Ambergris and Musk. JC Crystal by Jamharian Perfume is an aromatic aquatic fragrance released in 2019 and presented as a unisex composition. It opens with a breezy combination of ozone, lavender and lemon, creating a fresh, airy and slightly citrusy impression. The heart introduces spearmint, lily and clary sage, adding cool herbal nuances and a light floral touch. In the base, orris root blends with musk and ambergris to give the scent a soft, slightly powdery and marine-tinged drydown. The overall character is clean, airy and subtly marine, suitable for those who enjoy fresh, aromatic compositions with a gentle aquatic feel.

name: Dora and Boots
description: Dora and Boots by Dora The Explorer is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women. Top notes are Green Apple, Pink Grapefruit, Melon and Tangerine; middle notes are Magnolia, Sugar, Candy apple and Freesia; base notes are White Amber and White Wood.

name: JC White
description: JC White by Jamharian Perfume is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. JC White was launched in 2019. JC White was created by Vartan Jamharian and Mohammad Al Attar. Top notes are Jasmine and Amber; middle notes are Heliotrope and Tuberose; base notes are Vanilla Pod, Patchouli and Musk. JC White by Jamharian Perfume is an amber-floral fragrance created for a unisex audience and released in 2019. The composition opens with a warm blend of amber and jasmine, leading into a floral heart where tuberose and heliotrope add creamy, powdery nuances. In the base, patchouli is wrapped in vanilla pod and soft musk, giving the perfume a smooth, slightly sweet and sensual drydown while maintaining a floral-amber character.

name: Gary
description: Gary by SpongeBob Squarepants is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. Top notes are Citruses and Orange Blossom; middle notes are Coconut Nectar, Vanilla Flower and Amber; base notes are Driftwood, Musk and Sandalwood.

name: JC Green
description: JC Green by Jamharian Perfume is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. JC Green was launched in 2019. JC Green was created by Mohammad Al Attar and Vartan Jamharian. Top notes are Vanilla and Peony; middle notes are Magnolia and Freesia; base notes are Amber and Musk. JC Green by Jamharian Perfume is a unisex fragrance that combines amber, floral, and woody facets. It opens with an unusual blend of black vanilla, wet wood and peony, bringing together creamy sweetness, damp wood nuances and a soft floral touch. The heart is built around magnolia and freesia, adding a light, airy floral character that softens the darker undertones of the composition. In the base, woods, amber and musk create a warm and gently resinous foundation with a smooth, musky finish. The result is a balanced scent that shifts from textured, slightly atmospheric top notes to a more comfortable, woody-amber drydown.

name: Fleurie Emerald Green
description: Fleurie Emerald Green by Riiffs Perfumes is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Fleurie Emerald Green was launched in 2025. Top notes are Lemon Peel, Blood Orange and Lavender; middle notes are Anise, Licorice, White Flowers and Cinnamon; base notes are Vanilla Bean, Caramel and Musk. Fleurie Emerald by Riiffs is an Eau de Parfum that opens with vibrant citrus and herbal accents, transitions into a warm, spicy heart enriched with white florals, and settles into a sweet, musky dry-down. The composition balances freshness with opulent oriental sweetness.

name: Sama
description: Sama by Nusuk is a Aromatic Aquatic fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Sama was launched in 2025. Top notes are Lemon and Bergamot; middle notes are Ozonic notes, Sage and Geranium; base notes are Moss, Musk and Light Amber. Sama is a fresh, uplifting fragrance designed for men, balancing crisp citrus top notes with aquatic heart notes and a soft woody-amber base. It opens with bright bergamot and lemon, transitions into an ozonic accord blended with aromatic sage and geranium, and settles into a clean foundation of mineral amber, musk, and moss. The composition evokes refined freshness with moderate projection and longevity suitable for daily wear.

name: JC Red
description: JC Red by Jamharian Perfume is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. JC Red was launched in 2019. JC Red was created by Vartan Jamharian and Mohammad Al Attar. Top notes are White Lily, Magnolia, Jasmine and Violet; middle notes are Green Apple and Bergamot; base notes are Vanilla, Amber and Musk. JC Red by Jamharian Perfume is an amber floral fragrance for women and men, released in 2019. The composition opens with a bouquet of jasmine, magnolia, white lily and violet, bringing together creamy white florals and a soft, powdery floral nuance. A heart of green apple and bergamot introduces a crisp, lightly tart fruitiness that contrasts with the floral top. In the base, woody notes, amber, powdery vanilla and sheer musk create a warm, gently sweet and musky drydown, giving the scent a soft, enveloping character.

name: JC Brown
description: JC Brown by Jamharian Perfume is a Oriental Spicy fragrance for women and men. JC Brown was launched in 2019. JC Brown was created by Mohammad Al Attar and Vartan Jamharian. Top notes are Bergamot, Verbena, Violet and Pepper; middle notes are Bulgarian Rose, Nutmeg, Ginger and Iris; base notes are Patchouli, Vanilla, Leather, Amber and Musk. JC Brown by Jamharian Perfume is an amber spicy floral fragrance released in 2019 and presented as a unisex composition. The scent opens with a combination of bergamot, pepper, verbena and violet, blending fresh citrus, aromatic and lightly powdery facets. The heart centers on Bulgarian rose, nutmeg, ginger and iris, bringing together floral warmth and gentle spice with a soft, cosmetic nuance. In the base, patchouli, leather, vanilla, amber and musk create a deeper foundation, adding earthy, leathery, sweet and resinous tones that give the fragrance a lasting and rounded character.

name: JC Violet
description: JC Violet by Jamharian Perfume is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women and men. JC Violet was launched in 2019. JC Violet was created by Mohammad Al Attar and Vartan Jamharian. Top notes are Red Fruits, Rhubarb and Kiwi; middle notes are Cyclamen and Melon; base notes are Sandalwood and Musk. JC Violet by Jamharian Perfume is a unisex floral fruity fragrance released in 2019. It opens with a bright and tart blend of rhubarb, red fruits, and kiwi, creating a contrast between crisp acidity and gentle sweetness. The heart introduces cyclamen and sweet melon, adding a soft floral tone and a juicy, watery nuance. In the base, musk and sandalwood provide a smooth, slightly creamy foundation that grounds the composition without overpowering the fruit and floral elements. The overall impression is a modern, approachable scent that balances fresh fruit notes with a gentle musky-woody drydown.

name: Tigran Silver
description: Tigran Silver by Jamharian Perfume is a Oriental Spicy fragrance for women and men. Tigran Silver was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Vartan Jamharian. Top notes are Cinnamon and Honey; middle notes are Orange Blossom and Rose; base notes are Musk Mallow, Ambroxan, Ambrette, Agarwood and Oud.

name: Tigran Gold
description: Tigran Gold by Jamharian Perfume is a fragrance for women and men. Tigran Gold was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Vartan Jamharian. Top notes are Blackberry, Madagascar Cloves and Wild Orchid; middle notes are Pink Pepper, Orange Blossom and Indian Jasmine; base notes are Agarwood, Vanilla and Oud.

name: JC Black
description: JC Black by Jamharian Perfume is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. JC Black was launched in 2019. JC Black was created by Vartan Jamharian and Mohammad Al Attar. Top notes are Amber and Musk; middle notes are Chocolate and Vanilla; base notes are Bergamot, Cardamom and Lime. JC Black by Jamharian Perfume is an amber gourmand fragrance created for a unisex audience and released in 2019. The scent centers on a warm, edible character built around chocolate and creamy vanilla, supported by woods, musk, and amber for depth and a smooth, slightly resinous undertone. Citrus nuances of bergamot and lime, together with cardamom, add a fresher and lightly spicy contrast to the composition. The structure of JC Black combines soft, comforting notes with brighter and more aromatic facets, aiming for a balance between sweetness, warmth, and subtle freshness. It can be suitable for those who enjoy chocolate-vanilla accords framed by amber, musk, and woods, with a touch of citrus and spice to keep the blend from becoming overly dense.

name: Bellodgia Extrait
description: Bellodgia Extrait by Caron is a Oriental fragrance for women. Bellodgia Extrait was launched in 1927. The nose behind this fragrance is Ernest Daltroff. Top notes are Carnation and Rose; middle notes are Jasmine, Violet and Lily-of-the-Valley; base notes are Cloves, Musk, Vanilla and Sandalwood.

name: Palace Oud
description: Palace Oud by Thameen is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. Palace Oud was launched in 2013. The fragrance features Taif Rose, Indian Oud, Agarwood (Oud), Amber, Sandalwood, Egyptian Jasmine and Atlas Cedar. “The scents commonly used in these Palaces such as oud, jasmin and Taif rose are at the heart of this limited edition. Incredibly rare, precious ingredients, handpicked and blended create this sublime and extravagant pure parfum oil. Rare Indian oud, aged for 12 years have been exclusively created for this fragrance. It is combined with high quality Indonesian oud and then sensually intertwined with intense notes of wild Egyptian jasmine and Arabian rose from Taif. Cedar wood from the Atlas mountains in Morocco has been enhanced with light notes of amber and the addition of a Cambodian sandalwood strengthens the woody impact of the precious oil. With only 100 bottles this fragrance is truly exclusive. Palace Oud is 30 ml of a pure fragrance oil, presented in an exclusive handmade decanter of the finest English crystal” — press release of the brand.

name: JC Blue
description: JC Blue by Jamharian Perfume is a Aromatic fragrance for women and men. JC Blue was launched in 2019. JC Blue was created by Mohammad Al Attar and Vartan Jamharian. Top notes are Lavender, Citrus, Anise, Lily and Sage; middle notes are Geranium, Jasmine and Rose; base notes are Ylang-Ylang, Carnation and Cinnamon. JC Blue by Jamharian Perfume is an aromatic unisex fragrance released in 2019. It opens with a bright and herbal blend of citrus, lavender, anise lily, and sage, setting a fresh yet slightly spicy tone. The heart introduces a classic floral trio of rose, geranium, and jasmine, adding softness and depth to the composition. In the base, ylang-ylang, spicy cinnamon, and carnation bring a warm, floral-spicy finish that anchors the fragrance and rounds out its aromatic character.

name: Golden Elixir Reserve
description: Golden Elixir Reserve by Riiffs Perfumes is a Oriental Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Golden Elixir Reserve was launched in 2024. Top notes are Cinnamon, Cognac, Coffee and Cardamom; middle notes are Praline, Dates and Tonka Bean; base notes are Vanilla, Agarwood and Musk.

name: Zumorod
description: Zumorod by Arabian Oud is a fragrance for women and men. Zumorod was launched in 2023. Top notes are Cardamom and Frankincense; middle notes are Madagascar Vanilla and Musk; base notes are Madagascar Vanilla and Musk.

name: Passion
description: Passion by Ermenegildo Zegna is a Oriental fragrance for men. Passion was launched in 2017. Top notes are Cognac and Rum; middle note is Olibanum; base notes are Saffron and Amber.

name: Tigran Black
description: Tigran Black by Jamharian Perfume is a fragrance for women and men. Tigran Black was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Vartan Jamharian. Top note is Rhubarb; middle note is Cedar; base notes are Leather, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood and Vetiver.

name: Ginger+Mist
description: Ginger+Mist by Michael Malul London is a Woody Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Ginger+Mist was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is Yann Vasnier. Top notes are Ginger, Bergamot, Pineapple, Cedar and Lemon; middle notes are Ginger, Coriander and Nutmeg; base notes are Akigalawood, Gin, Georgywood, Musk and Sandalwood. Ginger + Mist is a vibrant and sophisticated fragrance designed for those who seek a refreshing yet refined scent experience. This Eau de Parfum masterfully blends fresh citrus, spicy warmth, and woody elegance, making it perfect for both everyday wear and special occasions. The fragrance opens with a lively burst of bergamot and lemon, enhanced by the invigorating sharpness of ginger extract and the fresh, green touch of cedar leaf and pineapple. As the fragrance evolves, the heart reveals a perfectly balanced spice blend of coriander, additional ginger, smooth lavandin, and warm nutmeg, creating a dynamic and energizing core. The dry-down introduces an elegant fusion of Gin Delight accord, rich akigalawood, creamy sandalwood, and the modern woody nuances of georgywood, all anchored by a smooth, musky base.

name: Fareed
description: Fareed by Riiffs Perfumes is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for men. Fareed was launched during the 2020's. Top notes are Cardamom and Pepper; middle notes are Lavender, Geranium and Bergamot; base notes are Tonka, Cedarwood and Vetiver. Fareed by RiiFFS is a woody-spicy fragrance built around aromatic and slightly sweet tonalities. The composition opens with a warm, spicy pairing of cardamom and pepper, leading into a heart where lavender and geranium are brightened by bergamot. In the base, vetiver, tonka bean, and cedarwood provide a dry, woody and lightly creamy foundation, giving the scent a structured and polished character suitable for everyday or evening wear.

name: Vol de Nuit Extract
description: Vol de Nuit Extract by Guerlain is a Floral fragrance for women. Vol de Nuit Extract was launched in 1933. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Guerlain. The fragrance features Narcissus, Galbanum, Carnation, Violet, Rose and Jasmine.

name: Roi Sans Equipage
description: Roi Sans Equipage by Henry Jacques is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Roi Sans Equipage was launched in 2016. Top notes are Clary Sage, Bergamot and Pepper; middle notes are Tobacco, Patchouli and Jasmine; base notes are Leather, Woody Notes and Amber.

name: Monogram Imagination
description: Monogram Imagination by Louis Vuitton is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Monogram Imagination was launched in 2026. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Cavallier Belletrud. Top notes are Citruses and Bergamot; middle notes are Neroli and Spices; base notes are Chinese Black Tea, Ambroxan and Amber. Monogram Imagination by Louis Vuitton is a limited collector's edition of the men's fragrance Imagination, created to mark the 130th anniversary of the house's Monogram motif. The composition, signed by Master Perfumer Jacques Cavallier Belletrud, is built around an exceptionally high dose of Ambroxan and a modern interpretation of an amber accord, contrasted with luminous citrus notes. Chinese black tea obtained by carbon dioxide extraction adds an aromatic, slightly smoky nuance that reinforces the travel-inspired character of the scent.While the fragrance itself follows the structure of the original Imagination, this edition is distinguished by its specially designed, signed bottle and coordinated packaging that revisit classic Louis Vuitton signatures in contemporary tones.

name: Estee Extrait
description: Estee Extrait by Estée Lauder is a Floral Aldehyde fragrance for women. Estee Extrait was launched in 1968. Estee Extrait was created by Betty Busse and Bernard Chant. Top notes are Lily, Aldehydes, Coriander, Ylang-Ylang, Raspberry, Peach, Tuberose and Lemon; middle notes are Honey, Carnation, Lily-of-the-Valley, Orris Root, Rose, Iris and Jasmine; base notes are Oakmoss, Sandalwood, Styrax and Cedar.

name: Aoud Absolue Precieux
description: Aoud Absolue Precieux by Roja Dove is a Oriental Spicy fragrance for women and men. Aoud Absolue Precieux was launched in 2010. The nose behind this fragrance is Roja Dove. Top notes are Verbena, Lemon and Bergamot; middle notes are Rose de Mai, Geranium, Jasmine and Ylang-Ylang; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Patchouli, Leather, Rhubarb, Cinnamon, Nutmeg, Saffron, Vanilla, Ambergris, Musk, Cedar, Cashmirwood and Sandalwood.

name: White Regent Diamond
description: White Regent Diamond by Ibrahim Al Qurashi is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. White Regent Diamond was launched in 2025. Top notes are Sandalwood, Cardamom, Tea and Fig; middle notes are Iris and Vetiver; base notes are Tonka Bean, Vanilla and Patchouli. White Regent Diamond is an elegant fragrance that combines fresh and warm elements to create a sophisticated and balanced scent. It features an aromatic composition with top notes of fig, cardamom, tea, and sandalwood; heart notes of iris and vetiver; and base notes of tonka bean, patchouli, and vanilla. The fragrance transitions smoothly on skin, offering longevity of approximately eight hours with a refined evolution from fresh-spicy openings to woody-powdery drydown characteristics.

name: Agape
description: Agape by Thauy is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women and men. Agape was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Daniel Josier. Top notes are Rose Jam, Grapefruit and Cassia; middle notes are Vanilla Bean, Cistus Incanus and Jasmine; base notes are Ambergris and Agarwood (Oud). AGAPE, deriving its essence from the depths of Greek Mythology, epitomizes the concept of "unconditional love." AGAPE gracefully takes its place as the third jewel within "The Power Of Resilience Collection." Through this captivating scent, THAUY endeavors to impart upon the world the profound message of approaching all endeavors with an infinite wellspring of love and an illuminated soul. AGAPE serves as a radiant reminder to embrace every pursuit with a heart brimming with affection, fostering a spirit of harmony and compassion that permeates our very being. This enchanting unisex perfume is a sweet romantic and gourmand blend that exudes the essence of unconditional love. It opens with head notes of cassia, rose jam, and grapefruit, creating a delightful and uplifting introduction. The heart notes of ciste blossom, jasmine, and vanilla bean add a sense of tender affection. Finally, the base notes of oud and ambergris provide depth and sensuality. This fragrance captures the power of love in a captivating and concise composition, leaving a lasting. impression on those who encounter it. - a note from the brand.

name: Al Shams Special Edition
description: Al Shams Special Edition by Ajmal is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. The nose behind this fragrance is Nazir Ajmal. The fragrance features Agarwood (Oud).

name: Hersh 2
description: Hersh 2 by Alezz Oud is a Oriental Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Hersh 2 was launched in 2025. Top notes are Lemon, Calabrian bergamot and Sicilian Orange; middle notes are Nigerian Ginger, Tunisian Orange Blossom and Cinnamon; base notes are Ambroxan, Chinese Black Tea, Guaiac Wood and Frankincense. Hersh 2 by Al Ezz is a citrusy, spicy fragrance built around bright fruits and warm, resinous woods. The composition opens with a vivid blend of Calabrian bergamot, lemon and Sicilian orange, creating a fresh and zesty introduction. In the heart, Ceylonese cinnamon and Nigerian ginger add warmth and aromatic spice, softened by the floral nuance of Tunisian orange blossom. The base features ambroxan, Chinese black tea, frankincense and guaiac wood, giving the drydown a smoky, woody and slightly resinous character. The structure moves from sparkling citrus to a more complex, spicy-woody finish.

name: Pistachio Crème
description: Pistachio Crème by Victoria's Secret is a Aromatic fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Pistachio Crème was launched in 2024. The fragrance features Pistachio, Vanilla, Almond and Musk.

name: Wood Sage & Sea Salt
description: Wood Sage & Sea Salt by Jo Malone London is a Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Wood Sage & Sea Salt was launched in 2014. The nose behind this fragrance is Christine Nagel. The fragrance features Sea Salt, Sage, Grapefruit, Ambrette (Musk Mallow) and Seaweed. Jo Malone is launching the new Wood Sage & Sea Salt Cologne which arrives on the market in September 2014 accompanied with perfumed body care collection. The fragrance will be offered worldwide in the most important perfumeries as well as in duty free shops.Composition of the new fragrance, just like its name suggests, is composed of ambrette seed, sea salt and sage, along with red algae and grapefruit. ‘This fragrance is different for me’ – says Christine Nagel, perfumer of the composition. She adds: ‘Sea air is mixed with salty and mineral texture of sand and stones. As the scent of driftwood it has natural and fresh sophistication. A complex combination of wood and sea is in its essence. It provides the feeling of freedom and natural spirit.’Wood Sage & Sea Salt Cologne was created with the intention to evoke the feeling of pleasure, freedom and escape into nature, inspired by the unique character and quality of British beach. With the aim to reflect the whole idea, photos of the advertising campaign were taken in Northumberland by the British fashion photographer Tim Walker. Assortment of the collection Jo Malone Wood Sage & Sea Salt includes flacons of 30 and 100ml Cologne, 250ml Body & Hand Wash, 175ml Body Crème and 200g Home Candle.Recommendation of Jo Malone brand: the new fragrance goes perfectly and can be mixed with Lime Basil & Mandarin or Nectarine Blossom & Honey eau de cologne.

name: Not A Perfume
description: Not A Perfume by Juliette Has A Gun is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Not A Perfume was launched in 2010. The nose behind this fragrance is Romano Ricci. The fragrance features Cetalox. The new non-perfume is arriving from the house of Juliette Has a Gun in September 2010. Juliette Has a Gun Not a Perfume in not really a perfume but fragrant AMBROX in a flacon.C16 H28 O is formula of Ambroxan, the only key ingredient in this non-perfume. Ambrox was born in the 1950es in Firmenich as substitute for grey amber which was very expensive for a common use in compositions. Ambrox is typically used as one of base notes of compositions, while it has a leading role in this non-perfume.Juliette Has A Gun Not a Perfume is a provocative declaration which does not follow the rules of modern perfumery. Not a Perfume is based on contradictions, since its composition is created of molecules and is the only fragrance without allergens.Not a Perfume is available in characteristic flacons of 50 and 100ml.

name: Bois Impérial
description: Bois Impérial by Essential Parfums is a Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Bois Impérial was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Quentin Bisch. The fragrance features Akigalawood, Woodsy Notes, Basil, Vetiver, Timur, Ambroxan and Patchouli.

name: Santal 33
description: Santal 33 by Le Labo is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Santal 33 was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is Frank Voelkl. The fragrance features Sandalwood, Leather, Papyrus, Virginia Cedar, Cardamom, Violet, Iris and Amber.

name: Chergui
description: Chergui by Serge Lutens is a Oriental Spicy fragrance for women and men. Chergui was launched in 2001. The nose behind this fragrance is Christopher Sheldrake. The fragrance features Tobacco Leaf, Honey, Amber, Hay, Incense, Sandalwood, Iris, Musk and Rose.

name: Womanity
description: Womanity by Mugler is a fragrance for women. Womanity was launched in 2010. Womanity was created by Mane, Alexis Dadier and Ralf Schwieger. The fragrance features Fig, Caviar, Fig Tree and Fig Leaf. 18 years after Angel and 5 years after extraordinary Alien, Thierry Mugler is saluting femininity. The new edition will thrill all fans of his creations. It is named Womanity and it arrives in stores in mid-June 2010. Thierry Mugler with Womanity plans to launch (for the third time) a bestseller perfume and which will attract the public for years.Womanity is a word created to connect femininity, humanity and city. An overture to this edition began in March 2010 when Mugler launched Womanity.com web site with an idea that every woman cooperates in its creation and finishing touch. With an aim to create contents for the website, one story is finished by several women, each of them writing on her page. Contest asks women to give creative ideas for a particular project or cause. The winner will work with Mugler to finish the website.Fragrance WOMANITY was created as a part of this phenomenon, in a pink bottle. Connections between women are presented as chains and ring on top of the bottle which is decorated with metal frieze with symbolic design. Design of the top part of the bottle and beautiful frieze figures can be interpreted as Gothic or Art Deco style. Mugler's idea was however that the frieze encapsulated and depicted women of all generations.Composition of Womanity was created by Mane, as a powerful contrast of elements. By using the new molecular process of extraction, Mane manages to extract natural aromas of fig for sweet accords. Savory notes originate from caviar and the structure in ensured by fig wood aromas. Pierre Aulas, olfactive director of Clarins Fragrance Group, says that it is a true challenge to work on Mugler's idea of combining savoury and sweet notes.

name: Molecule 01
description: Molecule 01 by Escentric Molecules is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for women and men. Molecule 01 was launched in 2006. The nose behind this fragrance is Geza Schoen. The fragrance features Iso E Super.

name: Seminalis
description: Seminalis by Orto Parisi is a fragrance for women and men. Seminalis was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Alessandro Gualtieri.

name: Thunderstorm
description: Thunderstorm by Demeter Fragrance is a fragrance for women and men. Thunderstorm was launched in 2009. Thunderstorm is a fragrance presented in April 2009, in a collection which encompasses Rain, Thunderstorm and Holy Water. Thunderstorm is a fragrance which represents the strong and rough side of nature, thunder of summer storm. The fragrance is available as 15ml purse spray, 15ml cologne spray, 30ml cologne spray, 125ml cologne spray...

name: Moringa
description: Moringa by The Body Shop is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Moringa was launched in 2012.

name: Shea
description: Shea by The Body Shop is a Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Shea was launched in 2012.

name: Black No. 05
description: Black No. 05 by Puredistance is a fragrance for women and men. Black No. 05 was launched in 2013. The nose behind this fragrance is Antoine Lie. Puredistance BLACK is created in Paris by the famous French Perfumer Antoine Lie. He created a perfume of the highest quality that is close to the wearer and releases sensual and elegant scent layers in a whispering and sophisticated way – without shouting. A warm, mysterious and elegant fragrance, full of charm, that stays in the shadow, giving away – only every now and then – part of its nature. Puredistance BLACK plays hide-and-seek on the skin, appearing, morphing, and reappearing to delight the senses.

name: Santal Noir
description: Santal Noir by Dior is a fragrance for women and men. Santal Noir was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy.

name: Kitten Fur
description: Kitten Fur by Demeter Fragrance is a fragrance for women and men. Kitten Fur was launched in 2017.

name: Rain
description: Rain by Demeter Fragrance is a fragrance for women and men. Rain was launched in 2009. Rain is a fragrance presented in April 2009. It is very strange and almost impossible to describe, since it reinterprets a complex moment of rain in spring. Rain is the purest and the most crystal-like perfume of the entire Demeter collection. It is available as 15ml purse spray, 15ml cologne spray, 30ml cologne spray, 125ml cologne spray...

name: Go Fruity
description: Go Fruity by Zara is a Aromatic Fruity fragrance for women. Go Fruity was launched in 2020.

name: I'm A Musk
description: I'm A Musk by Fine'ry. is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. I'm A Musk was launched in 2023.

name: Celine Dion
description: Celine Dion by Celine Dion is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. The nose behind this fragrance is Patricia Bilodeau. Top notes are Orange Blossom, Tiare Flower and Yellow Rose; middle notes are Lily-of-the-Valley, Red Berries, Violet and Jasmine; base notes are White Woods, Sandalwood, Musk and Amber. Celine Dione is a translucent and dewy fragrance with floral and fruity notes. It is perfect for a passionate, gentle and cheerful woman, like Celine Dione herself. The perfume starts with floral notes combined with warm amber, musk and woody notes. It is good for everyday use, but due to its refined and complex composition, it could be used in special occasions, too. Its main notes are: red fruit, heliotrope, bergamot, lily, cyclamen, violet, mandarin orange, jasmine, sandalwood, amber and musk.

name: Celine Dion Parfum Notes
description: Celine Dion Parfum Notes by Celine Dion is a Floral fragrance for women. Celine Dion Parfum Notes was created by Jean-Pierre Bethouart and Jean Claude Delville. Top notes are Water Lily, Gardenia, Nectarine and Mimosa; middle notes are Peony, Orchid and Heliotrope; base notes are Vetiver, Australian Sandalwood, White Musk and Guaiac Wood.

name: Chevignon For Men
description: Chevignon For Men by Chevignon is a Oriental Woody fragrance for men. Top notes are Juniper Berries, Artemisia, Caraway, Basil, Bergamot and Green Notes; middle notes are Caraway, Geranium, Carnation, Lily-of-the-Valley, Jasmine and Rose; base notes are Cedar, Oakmoss, Leather, Amber, Patchouli and Musk. Chevignon Brand was created in spirit of minimalism. The bouquet is simple (citrusy, spicy and woody), but very quality and masculine. Bearing in mind that America is the muse for this brand, the perfume smells and looks very American - American men like strong and simple fragrances. The package has a shape of whiskey bottle.

name: Par Amour
description: Par Amour by Clarins is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. The nose behind this fragrance is Raphael Haury. Top notes are Pink Pepper, Cassia and Black Currant; middle notes are Turkish Rose, Vanilla and Cardamom; base notes are Sandalwood, Amber, Benzoin and Labdanum. The French cosmetic house of Clarins has launched Par Amour, its first fragrance for young ladies. The perfume has an unusual composition - combination of floral, fruity and woody notes blooming together. In the top there are notes of pink pepper and black currant. The heart is composed of Turkish rose and vanilla, and the base includes sandalwood and benzoin.

name: Cafe Intenso
description: Cafe Intenso by Cafe Parfums is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. Top notes are Bamboo Leaf, Mandarin Orange, Grapefruit, Orange and Apple; middle notes are Lily, Lily-of-the-Valley and Lotus; base notes are Vanilla, Coffee, Sandalwood and Musk. This strong and intensive aroma is very shocking and sensual. The composition opens with notes of apple, mandarin, grapefruit and bamboo. The heart belongs to lily, lotus and lily of the valley. The base notes are gourmet and opulent: vanilla, sandalwood , coffee and musk.

name: Cafe-Cafe Puro Iced
description: Cafe-Cafe Puro Iced by Cafe Parfums is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Top notes are Grapefruit and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Pear and Jasmine; base note is Cedar. Refreshing perfume Cafe-Cafe Puro Iced is an original blend of fresh and floral notes, which are musky, warm, gentle and intensive. The main notes are: mint, rose, jasmine, lily of the valley, woody notes, white musk, cedar, sandalwood. This perfume will cool you on summer day.

name: Chaumet L'eau
description: Chaumet L'eau by Chaumet is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. The nose behind this fragrance is Louise Turner. Top notes are Tea, Chinese Red Currant and Sicilian Bergamot; middle notes are Mimosa, Wild Jasmine and Rose; base notes are Almond Tree, Sandalwood and White Musk.

name: Diesel Green Masculine
description: Diesel Green Masculine by Diesel is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Top notes are Green Notes, Fir and Canadian Fir; middle notes are Jasmine, Mandarin Orange, Cyclamen, Blue Rose, Iris, Orchid, Carnation, Geranium and Ginger; base notes are Sandalwood, Musk, Cedar, Incense and Amber.

name: Cool Water Deep
description: Cool Water Deep by Davidoff is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. The nose behind this fragrance is Nathalie Lorson. Top notes are Mandarin Orange, Kiwi, Cactus, Juniper and Apple; middle notes are Fir Resin, Cedar Needles and Clary Sage; base notes are Hinoki Wood, Guaiac Wood, Elemi resin, Labdanum and White Musk.

name: Pleasures Exotic
description: Pleasures Exotic by Estée Lauder is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Top notes are Tropical Fruits, Mango, Pink Grapefruit, Peach, Lemongrass and Orange; middle notes are Litchi, Peony, Green Leaves, Hibiscus, Lily-of-the-Valley, Bamboo, Cassia and Orange Blossom; base notes are Sandalwood, Musk and Woody Notes. Pleasures Exotic is a floral-fruity fragrance which will for sure be appealing to those who love the scent of exotic fruits in a fragrance. The top notes are sunny, joyous and mouthwatering: green leaves, pink grapefruit, orange, and lemongrass. The heart notes are translucent and dewy, composed of a number of flowers and exotic spices: bamboo flower, hibiscus, orange blossom, followed by litchi, and apricot, opulent peony, rose, rare flower Bougainvillea Vine and Baie rose. The base introduces exotic woods and amber.

name: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely
description: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely by Giorgio Armani is a Oriental Fougere fragrance for men. Emporio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Cecile Matton. Top notes are Rum, elemi and Bergamot; middle notes are Lavender and Davana; base notes are Madagascar Vanilla, Chestnut, Cedar and Patchouli.

name: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Coral Fantasy
description: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Coral Fantasy by Valentino is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Coral Fantasy was launched in 2022. Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Coral Fantasy was created by Nicolas Beaulieu and Jean-Christophe Hérault. Top notes are Red Apple, Cardamom and Calabrian bergamot; middle notes are Lavender, Bourbon Geranium and Clary Sage; base notes are Tobacco Leaf, Patchouli and Haitian Vetiver.

name: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo - Fico di Amalfi
description: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo - Fico di Amalfi by Acqua di Parma is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women and men. Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo - Fico di Amalfi was launched in 2006. Top notes are Grapefruit, Bergamot, Citron and Lemon; middle notes are Fig Nectar, Jasmine and Pink Pepper; base notes are Fig Tree, Cedar and Benzoin. Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo - Fico di Amalfi was presented in 2006 as a floral-fruity fragrance for women.The top notes bring the Italian breeze from the Mediterranean, with fresh and sweet notes of bergamot, orange, luminous lemon, dazzling bittery grapefruit and mandarin wood. A heart is composed of fig, pink pepper and jasmine, while a base is full of musk, cedar and fig milk.It comes as 60ml and 120ml (2 and 4 oz)EDT with matching body care products.

name: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo - Mandorlo di Sicilia
description: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo - Mandorlo di Sicilia by Acqua di Parma is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo - Mandorlo di Sicilia was launched in 1999. Top notes are Green Almond, Star Anise, Orange and Bergamot; middle notes are White Peach, Ylang-Ylang and Jasmine; base notes are Bourbon Vanilla, Tolu Balsam, White Musk and Cedar. Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo - Mandorlo di Sicilia was presented in 1999 as an oriental-floral unisex fragrance.The top notes bring the touches of Sicily with sweet freshness of bergamot, united with Frangipani flower, orange blossom, green almond, and star anise. The heart introduces the notes of white peach, coffee grains and white jasmine. The base is composed of velvety and powdery Bourbon vanilla, light musk, cedar and milky warm sandal wood. It is available as 60ml and 120ml EDT.

name: I Don't Need A Prince By My Side To Be A Princess
description: I Don't Need A Prince By My Side To Be A Princess by By Kilian is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. I Don't Need A Prince By My Side To Be A Princess was launched in 2018. Top note is Lemon; middle notes are Green Tea, Ginger, Peach, Hedione, Jasmine and Apple; base notes are Marshmallow, Vanilla and Benzoin. By Kilian, the Estée Lauder -owned fragrance artisanal brand, launched a lower-priced line at Sephora in August 2018 named My Kind of Love. The concept is to choose a flavor of love which corresponds with the different scents: fun, sparkling, hot and sweet."I wanted to amp up the girl power with a unique scent calling out all fierce females. Gourmand with a kick, Princess is like sipping on a green tea matcha with a tip of ginger on the nose for sassy spice."— Kilian Hennessy.Available as a 30, 50 and 100ml EDP.

name: Allure Homme Edition Blanche Eau de Parfum
description: Allure Homme Edition Blanche Eau de Parfum by Chanel is a Oriental Woody fragrance for men. Allure Homme Edition Blanche Eau de Parfum was launched in 2014. Top notes are Lemon and Bergamot; middle notes are Sandalwood and Woody Notes; base notes are Madagascar Vanilla and Vetiver.

name: L'Instant de Guerlain pour Homme Eau Extreme
description: L'Instant de Guerlain pour Homme Eau Extreme by Guerlain is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. L'Instant de Guerlain pour Homme Eau Extreme was launched in 2005. The nose behind this fragrance is Beatrice Piquet. Top notes are Star Anise, Citruses and elemi; middle notes are Tea, Jasmine and Neroli; base notes are Cacao, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Virginia Cedar and Hibiscus. L'Instant de Guerlain Pour Homme Eau Extreme is launched in 2005 as the more intense, richer, smokier and deeper version of the original fragrance. The perfume opens with notes of crystal citruses, star anise and elemi. Neroli, patchouli flower, Indian jasmine and Lapsang tea are the heart of the composition, laid on the base of cedar, Mysore sandalwood, cocoa, patchouli and hibiscus seed. The nose is Beatrice Piquet.  It is available as 75 ml Eau de Parfum.

name: Hermann à mes Côtés me Paraissait une Ombre
description: Hermann à mes Côtés me Paraissait une Ombre by Etat Libre d'Orange is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Hermann à mes Côtés me Paraissait une Ombre was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Quentin Bisch. Top notes are Pepperwood™, Galbanum and Black Currant; middle notes are Geosmin, Rose Oil and Olibanum; base notes are Ambroxan, Patchouli, Calypsone and Vetiver.

name: Les Creations de Monsieur Dior Forever and Ever
description: Les Creations de Monsieur Dior Forever and Ever by Dior is a Floral fragrance for women. Les Creations de Monsieur Dior Forever and Ever was launched in 2009. Top note is Freesia; middle note is Jasmine; base note is Tincture of Rose. The house of Dior has rightfully held one of the first places in the world of perfumes for years. Dior’s collection Les Creations de Monsieur Dior introduced in 2009 represents a review of vintage editions. The collection includes 5 perfumes – 5 classic fragrances favorized by many women worldwide.Diorella, Dioressence, Diorissimo, Eau Fraiche Forever and Ever make the five fragrances of the Les Creations de Monsieur Dior collection, presented as timeless opus of Dior which resists time and new trends.Romantic violet nuances announce the last fragrance of the Creations de Monsieur Dior Forever and Ever collection while insinuating Dior's timeless compositions which will be worn by next generations.Forever and Ever was presented in 2002 as a sophisticated floral composition which leaves a mild, spicy trail in a base. A floral bouquet of freesia, jasmine, rose, pelargonium and almond blossom are refreshed with ivy and spiced with nutmeg, vanilla and musk.The new version of Les Creations de Monsieur Dior Forever and Ever is available in a lovely glass flacon (50 and 100 ml EDT) with an accentuated floral light-motive of the composition. Pink nuances of the fragrance were inspired by rose-garden Dior Granville. Top notes of the perfume bloom with freesia flowers, a heart hides jasmine from India, while a base is enriched with intoxicating Bulgarian rose-garden.

name: Burberry Her
description: Burberry Her by Burberry is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women. Burberry Her was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. Top notes are Strawberry, Raspberry, Blackberry, Sour Cherry, Black Currant, Mandarin Orange and Lemon; middle notes are Violet and Jasmine; base notes are Musk, Vanilla, Cashmeran, Woody Notes, Amber, Oakmoss and Patchouli. Burberry Her, a new pillar fragrance for the house, comes out in October 2018 and is the first one whose packaging is marked with the new logo.Burberry Her is designed to capture the youthful spirit of the city of London, the creative and eclectic metropolis; a spirit that is lively, adventurous and brave. It is made for those women who feel Londoners at heart. The composition is signed by Francis Kurkdjian as his interpretation of a floral-fruity theme with gourmand undertones. Crushed berry fruit from the top is combined with middle notes of violet and jasmine, based on woods and amber."Her Eau de Parfum by Burberry is unique because it is a memorable signature. To achieve that, you need a strong accord, an olfactory story that translates your vision.  The combination of these sunburst berries and British spirit blended with the ambery musky accord brings this very unique signature. You can immediately recognize when someone is wearing it. It is a signature scent." - Francis KurkdjianThe face of perfume is model Cara Delavigne, representing her home city. Burberry Her is available as a 30, 50 and 100 ml Eau de Parfum.

name: Amor Amor
description: Amor Amor by Cacharel is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Amor Amor was launched in 2003. Amor Amor was created by Laurent Bruyere and Dominique Ropion. Top notes are Black Currant, Orange, Mandarin Orange, Grapefruit, Cassia and Bergamot; middle notes are Rose, Apricot, Jasmine, Lily and Lily-of-the-Valley; base notes are Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Musk, Amber and Virginia Cedar. Amor Amor is a floral fruity nectar for young women who seek a love adventure. The main notes are pink grapefruit, mandarin, blood orange, Malati Flower (a very fragrant Indonesian jasmine sambac), lily-of-the-valley, white musk, sandalwood, vanilla, and ambergris. The perfume was created by Laurent Bruyere and Dominique Ropion in 2003.

name: Un Jardin Sur Le Nil
description: Un Jardin Sur Le Nil by Hermès is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women and men. Un Jardin Sur Le Nil was launched in 2005. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean-Claude Ellena. Top notes are Grapefruit, Green Mango, Tomato and Carrot; middle notes are Lotus, Bulrush, Orange, Hiacynth and Peony; base notes are Musk, Iris, Incense, Labdanum and Cinnamon. Un Jardin sur le Nil: composed in 2005, this is the second destination in this impressionistic travel journal. A stroll in the garden islands of the Nile at Assouan is the starting point for this new olfactory voyage.Green mango, lotus, incense, calamus and sycamore wood are at the heart of this refreshing ode.

name: Khamrah Qahwa
description: Khamrah Qahwa by Lattafa Perfumes is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. Khamrah Qahwa was launched in 2023. Top notes are Cinnamon, Cardamom and Ginger; middle notes are Praline, Candied Fruits and White Flowers; base notes are Vanilla, Coffee, Tonka Bean, Benzoin and Musk.

name: Grand Soir
description: Grand Soir by Maison Francis Kurkdjian is a Oriental fragrance for women and men. Grand Soir was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. Top notes are Spanish Labdanum and Orange; middle notes are Lavender and Siam Benzoin; base notes are Amber, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Musk and Cedar.

name: Cedrat Boise
description: Cedrat Boise by Mancera is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Cedrat Boise was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is Pierre Montale. Top notes are Sicilian Lemon, Bergamot, Black Currant and Spicy Notes; middle notes are Fruity Notes, Patchouli Leaf and Water Jasmine; base notes are Cedar, Leather, Sandalwood, Vanilla, White Musk and Moss.

name: Red Tobacco
description: Red Tobacco by Mancera is a Woody Spicy fragrance for women and men. Red Tobacco was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Pierre Montale. Top notes are Cinnamon, Agarwood (Oud), Incense, Saffron, Nutmeg, Green Apple and White Pear; middle notes are Patchouli and Jasmine; base notes are Tobacco, Madagascar Vanilla, Amber, Sandalwood, Guaiac Wood, White Musk and Haitian Vetiver.
